filter: fourth-order zero-phase Butterworth SOS applied to full recording before slicing
standardization_primary: common frozen 60-s Stage 06 feature mean and sample SD
standardization_secondary: within-duration sample SD, derived from the same raw coefficient
random_effects: woman random intercept plus recording variance component
multiplicity: BH-FDR separately across 34 UC-versus-IN p-values within each duration
magnitude_stability_rule: same sign and both common-scale duration estimates within 20% of frozen when abs(frozen)>=0.10; otherwise both absolute differences <=0.05 frozen SD
central_pattern_rule: all four core features positive at every duration and at least three of four individually direction-and-magnitude stable; any duration-additive exception must be named and qualified
design_lock_timing: defined after pipeline audit and before inspecting regenerated 40-s/80-s feature outcomes
